Guideline Name 
Dificid (fidaxomicin)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
9/1/2025  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Preferred: Brand Dificid tablets; Non-Preferred: generic fidaxomicin tablets, 
Brand Dificid oral suspension  
Approval Length 
10 Day(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of Clostridioides difficile-associated diarrhea (CDAD) [previously known as 
Clostridium difficile- associated diarrhea]  
 
AND 


=== PDF PAGE 456 ===
Page 456 
 
2 - BOTH of the following:  
 
 2.1 One of the following:  
• 
History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to generic vancomycin oral solution  
• 
For continuation of prior Dificid therapy  
 
AND 
 
 2.2 Trial and failure, or intolerance to Brand Dificid tablets (applies to requests for generic 
fidaxomicin and Brand Dificid suspension only)
